behaviour: The dialogs File Explorer opens: Properties sheets, Folder Options, file operations, conflicts and errors, and the wizards.

label: Taskbar progress
behaviour: While a file operation runs, the File Explorer button on the taskbar shows its progress, in the states ITaskbarList3 defines: normal (green), paused (yellow), error (red). Not read from the reference: UI Automation does not expose a taskbar button's progress.

label: Long paths
behaviour: A copy into a folder whose path passes 260 characters completes with no message: File Explorer wrote a 328-character path with LongPathsEnabled off (reference build, 2026-11-20). The Destination Path Too Long dialog did not show.

label: Eject while in use
behaviour: Eject on the DVD drive while a file on its disc is held open showed no dialog and left the disc loaded (the reference VM's virtual drive, 2026-11-20).
